name: Starlight Theatre (Kansas City, Missouri)
scope: The Cohen Community Stage House, its four brick towers and the open-air seating bowl at Starlight Theatre in Swope Park, in the configuration preceding the 2024 renovation.
era: Cohen Community Stage after 2000, with the bowl and stage house documented in 2008 and 2022.

originalReview.notes: Exact 1 August 2008 photograph already on Qualla. The photographer's original file revision releases the work into the public domain. The model follows the tower roofs, brick and truss detail and disposition of the seats.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with Charvex's exact public-domain Qualla original. The 2022 USDA orthophoto is public-domain plan evidence. OSM establishes the footprint, USGS the bowl grade, and theatre records the renovation sequence.
